仓库里还没有数据。: The warehouse holds no data yet.
仓库里还没有日线。: The warehouse holds no daily bars yet.
采集按交易所保存，分钟线按合约保存；已入库分区跳过。: Acquisition stores exchange partitions, or contract partitions for minutes; stored partitions are skipped.
每格为该来源已存日线的天数；没有交易日历时，完整性未知。: Each cell counts stored daily bars for this source. Completeness is unknown without a trading calendar.
重新采集已有分区，保留旧数据集版本: Reacquire stored partitions, preserving earlier dataset versions
录制状态不属于当前行情服务: Recording status belongs to another Market instance
连接远程 Market 后查看录制状态。: Connect to remote Market to view its recording status.
行情服务失联，录制状态未知。: Market is unreachable; recording status is unknown.
录制写入异常，部分数据可能丢失。: Recording writes failed; some data may be lost.
录制由 Market 独立运行；关闭 Terminal 不会停止。计数仅代表当前: Market records independently and continues after Terminal closes. Counts cover this instance only and do not establish historical completeness.
来源配置和凭据由 Market 主机管理；关闭此页面不会停止采集。: Sources and credentials are managed on the Market host. Closing this page does not stop acquisition.
当前连接只有读取权限，不能启动或取消采集。: This connection is read-only. It cannot start or cancel acquisitions.
Market 尚未启用采集来源，也没有已保存的数据集。: Market has no enabled acquisition sources or stored datasets.
重新发布已有分区，保留旧数据集版本: Republish existing partitions, keeping old dataset versions
将 Market 已落盘的分钟发布为研究版本，保留不完整分钟和观测中断；补录后可: Publish minutes already recorded by Market as a research version, preserving partial bars and observation gaps. Republish after more data arrives; old versions remain readable.
各来源分别采集和保存。研究只读「研究数据」：Market 按规则合成，日线和分钟: Each source is collected and stored on its own. Research reads only the research dataset, which Market composes by rule: Tushare's daily bars and minutes, and recorded minutes for contract days Tushare does not have.
两个来源都有的合约交易日 {days} 个，其中 {differing} 个不一: {days} contract days are held by both sources; {differing} of them disagree.
逐分钟比较开高低收和成交量；自录中标为不完整的分钟只计数，不比较。: Open, high, low, close and volume are compared minute by minute; recorded minutes marked partial are counted, not compared.
